data.one_liner: Provides localized strings for 77 cultures for Syncfusion Flutter widgets
data.what_it_does: This package supplies translated text for Syncfusion widgets, enabling apps to display UI in multiple languages. It supports a wide range of locales and is updated to work with recent Flutter SDKs.
use_when: You need localization for Syncfusion widgets in a multi‑language app
You want to avoid writing your own translation files for Syncfusion components
avoid_when: You are not using any Syncfusion widgets
You prefer a different localization solution like easy_localization or intl
strengths: Keeps translations in sync with Syncfusion widget updates
weaknesses: Requires a Syncfusion commercial or community license
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec.yaml, import the package, and set the locale in Syncfusion widgets. No build_runner or permissions needed.
